title: Gapped graphene model: shift current and SHG
summary: The honeycomb tight-binding model with a 1 eV sublattice gap (D3h): shift current, injection currents and second-harmonic susceptibility of the sheet from PAOFLOW.nonlinear_optics, with the selection rules yyy = -yxx = -xxy and xxx = 0. No DFT run; seconds.

steps.label: Shift current, injection currents and SHG of gapped graphene
steps.note: 300 x 300 k-points, a few seconds; writes output/
